subject: GCP marketplace onboarding & co-sell reconciliation for DataSpan — drawdown cadence
messages:
From: Anita Gupta <anita.gupta@googlepartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@dataspan.com>
Date: 2026-07-12T15:30:00Z
Subject: GCP private offer — initial PO and co-sell routing for DataSpan

Hi Marissa / Sergio,

Thanks for the quick sync last week. DataSpan is ready to move forward with a private offer on GCP. Attached is a template PO (GCP_PO_template.pdf) from the DataSpan procurement team. They are asking for:

- Private offer for a 12-month commit: $420,000 total (USD)
- Desired drawdown cadence: quarterly or as a monthly usage drawdown — they asked what Redwood recommends for co-sell tracking and reconciliation.

Action items from our side: please confirm the co-sell lead (GCP requires a named sales contact for co-sell reporting), confirm whether the drawdown should be configured as monthly or quarterly on the private offer, and confirm Redwood's billing contact for the marketplace flow.

Nina is looped in to confirm procurement timelines; she indicated a target start date of Aug 1.

Thanks,
Anita Gupta
Partner Manager, Google Cloud Marketplace
Google Cloud

Attachment: GCP_PO_template.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Anita Gupta <anita.gupta@googlepartner.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>, Nina Patel <nina@dataspan.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T09:05:00Z
Subject: Re: GCP private offer — initial PO and co-sell routing for DataSpan

Hi Anita / Nina,

Thanks — got the PO template. Quick responses inline below and next steps: 

- Co-sell lead: Marissa Cole (me) will be the named co-sell contact for GCP reporting. Karthik will support post-signature enablement.
- Billing contact for marketplace flows: accounting@redwood.com (I can put you in touch with our finance operations lead if needed).
- Drawdown recommendation: to balance customer cashflow preferences and our ability to recognize co-sell credit properly, we prefer a monthly drawdown configured as a scheduled monthly commitment reduction. That said, quarterly is fine if DataSpan’s procurement requires it.

Nina — can you confirm whether DataSpan prefers monthly invoicing or quarterly commitment draws? If monthly, we’ll propose a monthly drawdown schedule that aligns to $35,000/month (12 months). If quarterly, we’ll split into four equal draws of $105,000.

Next steps: Karthik will draft a proposed drawdown schedule and we’ll share back with Anita for GCP onboarding. Also, please confirm the GCP co-sell reporting alias you want on the private offer (gcp wants the partner manager + named rep).

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior GTM Manager, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-13T11:22:00Z
Subject: Draft drawdown schedule for DataSpan (internal)

Marissa / Sergio,

Per Marissa's note, I put together a proposed drawdown schedule we can present back to GCP and DataSpan: attached (redwood-drawdown-proposal.xlsx). Summary: 

Option A — Monthly drawdown (preferred):
- $35,000 deducted from the private offer each month for 12 months
- Easier for customer cashflow and reduces large one-off consumption spikes for reporting
- Recommended co-sell attribution: report monthly consumption + monthly co-sell credit

Option B — Quarterly drawdown (customer preference):
- $105,000 deducted at the start of each quarter (4 draws)
- Simpler for DataSpan procurement but delays some co-sell recognition to quarter boundaries

Questions for legal/procurement: do we need to include explicit refund or underrun clauses on the marketplace private offer (e.g., if DataSpan consumes less than the committed amount)? Also confirm whether we want GCP to issue invoices or if Redwood should invoice DataSpan directly post-draw.

If this schedule looks good, I can produce the final numbers and suggested private-offer metadata for Anita (rep names, co-sell alias, billing contact).

— Karthik
Product Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: redwood-drawdown-proposal.xlsx
From: Anita Gupta <anita.gupta@googlepartner.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Cc: Nina Patel <nina@dataspan.com>
Date: 2026-07-14T08:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Draft drawdown schedule for DataSpan / next steps

Thanks Karthik — this is clear and aligns with what DataSpan expected. They prefer Option A (monthly) but are okay with a quarterly fall-back if there are procurement constraints. A couple of quick asks so we can close onboarding on GCP: 

1) Please confirm co-sell contact as "Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>" — GCP will use that for partner reporting.
2) Please provide the billing contact for marketplace invoices (accounting@redwood.com is fine).
3) We need a signed PO (DataSpan -> Google private offer) and a short cover note that outlines the drawdown cadence so GCP can finalize the private offer metadata.

I’m going to open the private offer in our console once I have the signed PO. I’ve started a DocuSign envelope for the PO to accelerate signatures: https://www.docusign.com/12345-DataSpan-PO

If you can get me the signed PO and the one-page drawdown summary by COB Jul 15, we should be able to have the private offer live for an Aug 1 start.

Thanks,
Anita Gupta
Partner Manager, Google Cloud Marketplace
